request.query: Archimedean ordered field exists natural number greater than any finite maximum of real bounds

      "informal_name": "The Real Numbers are Archimedean",
      "kind": "instance",
      "type": "Archimedean ℝ",
      "informal_description": "The real numbers $\\mathbb{R}$ satisfy the Archimedean property: for any real numbers $a$ and $b$ with $0 < b$, there exists a natural number $n$ such that $a \\leq n \\cdot b$.",

    },
    {
      "formal_name": "ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderedField.to_archimedean",
      "informal_name": "Archimedean Property for Conditionally Complete Linearly Ordered Fields",
      "kind": "instance",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderedField α], Archimedean α",
      "informal_description": "Every conditionally complete linearly ordered field satisfies the Archimedean property: for any elements $a$ and $b$ with $0 < b$, there exists a natural number $n$ such that $a \\leq n \\cdot b$.",

    },

      "formal_name": "exists_nat_gt",
      "informal_name": "Archimedean Property of the Real Numbers",

      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "archimedean_iff_nat_lt",
      "informal_name": "Archimedean Property Characterization: Every Element is Bounded by a Natural Number",

items.informal_description: The real numbers $\mathbb{R}$ satisfy the Archimedean property: for any real numbers $a$ and $b$ with $0 < b$, there exists a natural number $n$ such that $a \leq n \cdot b$.

items.informal_name: Archimedean Property for Conditionally Complete Linearly Ordered Fields
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderedField α], Archimedean α
items.informal_description: Every conditionally complete linearly ordered field satisfies the Archimedean property: for any elements $a$ and $b$ with $0 < b$, there exists a natural number $n$ such that $a \leq n \cdot b$.

items.informal_name: Archimedean Property of the Real Numbers
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : PartialOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [Archimedean R] (x : R),
  ∃ n, x < ↑n
items.informal_description: For any real number $x$, there exists a natural number $n$ such that $x < n$.

items.informal_name: Archimedean Property: Existence of Natural Upper Bound
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] [Archimedean R] (x : R), ∃ n, x ≤ ↑n
items.informal_description: For every element $x$ in an Archimedean ordered semiring $R$, there exists a natural number $n$ such that $x \leq n$.

items.informal_name: Archimedean Property Characterization: Every Element is Bounded by a Natural Number
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_4} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K],
  Archimedean K ↔ ∀ (x : K), ∃ n, x < ↑n
items.informal_description: A structure $ K $ satisfies the Archimedean property if and only if for every element $ x \in K $, there exists a natural number $ n $ such that $ x < n $.
